findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_live_jobs, save_search, request_full_report · Private data: report_problem · Public sink: save_search, request_full_report, job_openings_index · Destructive: search_live_jobs.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_live_jobs, save_search, request_full_report · Private data: report_problem · Public sink: save_search, request_full_report, job_openings_index · Destructive: search_live_jobs

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
